verdict.rationale: Docusign Identify explicitly supports multiple stronger verification methods—ID document authenticity checks, biometric selfie challenge, SMS one-time-passcode, and risk-based dynamic verification—directly matching the requested SMS/ID/knowledge-based options, plus a '5 identity verifications' pricing feature reinforcing breadth. Missing for 10: no independent/hands-on corroboration of these verification features in practice and no explicit mention of knowledge-based authentication (KBA) by name.
